preconditions.description: The length of the string S must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz?' for c in S)
preconditions.description: The string S must only contain lowercase English letters and question marks.

postconditions.expression: stdout == -1 if not is_palindrome(S) else True
postconditions.description: If it is not possible to make the string a palindrome, the output must be -1.

postconditions.expression: stdout == sum(abs(ord(S[i]) - ord(S[i+1])) for i in range(len(S) - 1))
postconditions.description: If the string can be made a palindrome, the output must be the sum of the absolute differences of adjacent characters.
